verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's products page presents evidence packaging as a core service: it says it will "gather, polish, and package everything" from press to patents. It also claims narrative strategy, a start-to-approval checklist, an all-inclusive scope, attorney involvement and RFE minimization. Its reference-letter material is only self-serve guidance, though, and forms preparation and filing are never explicitly documented as part of the service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the provider drafts expert and support letters, explicit forms preparation and USCIS filing as included scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end execution.
